An '''order to reveal''' was a request made to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A person could request an order to reveal against any of the [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] of the Republic. It required several complicated steps, including signatures, petitions, approvals and seals, before it was approved. Once done, then the person requesting the order could read the files of the chosen Senator.

In [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his friend, the [[Svivreni]] [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrat]] [[Tyro Caladian]], filed one of those on Senator [[Sano Sauro]], whom they believe was committing several crimes. Sauro used his [[right of refusal]] to block the order indefinitely &mdash; something he should be legally unable to do, but the Senate Procedural Committee approved Sauro's request.
